prompt: In many countries the number of overweight children and teenagers has risen sharply in recent decades. What are the causes of this trend, and what measures could be taken to reverse it?
essay:
In the recent years, the problem of overweight children is increasing in many countries around the world. In this essay I will discuss the reasons of this problem and I will suggest some solutions which can solve it.

Firstly, one of the main reason is the fast food. Nowadays children eat a lot of burgers, pizza and fried chicken because these foods are very tasty and also cheap. Secondly, children do not do enough exercise. In the past, children were playing outside with their friends after the school, but nowadays they spend all their free time with the computer games and the mobile phones, so they do not burn the calories. Moreover, some parents are very busy with their job and they do not have the time to cook the healthy meal at home.

However, there are some solutions for this problem. Firstly, the government should take action and make the strong laws about this problem. Also, the schools should educate the children about the healthy food and about the danger of the obesity. In addition, the parents should control their children and they should not allow them to eat the junk food every day. If everybody do their part, this problem will be reduced.

In conclusion, the main causes of this problem are the fast food, the lack of the exercise and the busy parents, and the solutions are the government action, the education in the school and the control of the parents. I hope that in the future this problem will not be so serious.
title: Why young people are becoming heavier
